connectors.notes: REST uses OAuth2 client-credentials to mint a Bearer access token; sandbox is api-m.sandbox.paypal.com. PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT = SANDBOX|PRODUCTION.

connectors.name: Perplexity
connectors.summary: Run real-time web search, Q&A, deep research and reasoning with Perplexity Sonar models.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://api.perplexity.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" {"error":{"message":"Invalid API key provided...","type":"invalid_api_key"}}

connectors.notes: Remote MCP documented with 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>' (OAuth metadata also advertised).

connectors.name: Pika
connectors.summary: Generate and edit AI videos and images through your Pika Agent.
connectors.notes: URL from third-party guide (mcp.directory); https://mcp.pika.art/mcp also answers 401 with OAuth metadata. No official public API key flow found (Pika API historically via fal.ai).

connectors.name: Pipedrive
connectors.summary: Manage Pipedrive deals, persons, organizations, activities, leads and pipelines.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json; www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_request", error_description="Unauthorized: No API token or authorization header provided.", resource_metadata="https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"

connectors.notes: Official native MCP launched 2026 (Pipedrive newsroom); URL per tldv.io article, probe confirms. Also accepts API token. API token may alternatively be passed as ?api_token=.

connectors.name: PitchBook
connectors.summary: Research private companies, deals, investors, funds and valuations with PitchBook data.
connectors.notes: URL from directory listings (mcpservers.org); OAuth, requires PitchBook subscription. mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp also exists. PitchBook API is enterprise-only.

connectors.name: Plaid
connectors.summary: Debug Plaid Items, view Link conversion analytics and API usage for your Plaid integration (Dashboard MCP).
connectors.notes: Dashboard MCP URL documented at plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/ (OAuth, scope mcp:dashboard); probe returns plain 401 JSON without www-authenticate. https://mcp.plaid.com/mcp also answers with OAuth metadata. REST needs PLAID-CLIENT-ID + PLAID-SECRET headers (or in body); sandbox.plaid.com for testing.

connectors.name: PostHog
connectors.summary: Query PostHog product analytics, insights, feature flags, experiments, errors and dashboards.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 text/plain www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.posthog.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" No token provided, please provide a valid API token.

connectors.notes: Remote MCP supports OAuth or a personal API key as Bearer. EU cloud uses eu.posthog.com. @posthog/mcp on npm is an analytics SDK, not a server.

connectors.name: Postiz
connectors.summary: Schedule and publish social media posts across connected channels and upload media with Postiz.
connectors.notes: MCP accepts the API key as Authorization header (or /mcp/:apiKey path); self-hosted uses your backend URL. Probe has no www-authenticate. REST key is sent raw (no Bearer prefix). npm 'postiz' is a CLI agent, not an MCP server.

connectors.name: Postman
connectors.summary: Manage Postman workspaces, collections, environments, APIs, mocks and monitors.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.postman.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" {"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32600,"message":"Invalid Request: API key required"}}

connectors.notes: Remote MCP also accepts Postman API key as Bearer. npm supports --code/--full modes and --region eu.

connectors.name: Prisma
connectors.summary: Create and manage Prisma Postgres databases, run migrations and inspect schemas.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing Authorization header", resource_metadata="https://mcp.prisma.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"

connectors.notes: Local MCP is `npx -y prisma mcp` (Prisma CLI); npm 'latest' currently reports 8.0.0-rc.22. Management API for Prisma Postgres.

connectors.name: Product Hunt
connectors.summary: Browse Product Hunt posts, launches, topics, collections, comments and makers.
connectors.notes: mcp.producthunt.com/mcp exists but its OAuth server is Cloudflare Access (producthunt.cloudflareaccess.com) = internal, not public; only community MCP servers exist. API is GraphQL v2.

connectors.name: Prospeo
connectors.summary: Find and verify B2B email addresses and mobile numbers, and enrich person and company data.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.prospeo.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" {"error":"Missing or invalid authentication. Use Authorization: Bearer <token> or X-KEY: <your_api_key>"}

connectors.notes: MCP found by probing vendor subdomain root (/mcp path 404s); accepts OAuth or X-KEY API key. Vendor MCP docs page not located.

connectors.name: PushRank
connectors.summary: Manage SEO actions, topics and AI-written articles, and track Search Console and AI-search visibility for your site.
connectors.notes: PushRank = pushrank.io (pushrank.com is parked). MCP host taken from NEXT_PUBLIC_MCP_URL on app.pushrank.io/en/mcp, /mcp path confirmed by probe. No public REST API docs found.

connectors.name: Razorpay
connectors.summary: Create and manage Razorpay payments, orders, refunds, payment links, QR codes, settlements and payouts.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 {"error":{"code":"BAD_REQUEST_ERROR","description":"Please provide your api key for authentication purposes"}}

api.keyHelp: Razorpay Dashboard > Account & Settings > API Keys

connectors.notes: Remote MCP documented (razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/mcp-server/remote.md): header 'Authorization: Basic base64(key_id:key_secret)'; OAuth also supported. Probe has no www-authenticate. Local server is Go (not npm). Also needs RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET.

connectors.name: Reddit
connectors.summary: Search Reddit, read subreddits, posts and comments, and submit posts or replies.
connectors.notes: No official MCP. API requires OAuth2 (script/app credentials) and a descriptive User-Agent; docs URL returns 403 to curl (bot block).

connectors.name: Remote
connectors.summary: Query and manage Remote.com HR data: employees, countries, time off, payroll and employment details.
connectors.notes: Official MCP documented at developer.remote.com quick-start (sandbox: mcp.remote-sandbox.com/mcp). Sandbox REST base gateway.remote-sandbox.com.

connectors.name: Render
connectors.summary: Manage Render services, deploys, environment variables, logs, metrics and Postgres/Key Value databases.
connectors.notes: Render docs (render.com/docs/mcp-server) use 'Authorization: Bearer <RENDER_API_KEY>' for the hosted MCP; OAuth metadata also advertised. Local server is Go binary, not npm.

connectors.name: Replicate
connectors.summary: Search, run and manage AI models, predictions, deployments and trainings on Replicate.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer realm="OAuth", error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing or invalid access token"

connectors.notes: Docs list https://mcp.replicate.com (root POST 404s; /mcp and /sse answer 401 OAuth). npm maintained by replicatebot (infra@replicate.com); env name per Replicate docs.

connectors.name: Replit
connectors.summary: Build, run and deploy apps in Replit workspaces.
connectors.notes: No official MCP server or public REST API found (mcp.replit.com serves an HTML app page, not MCP).

connectors.name: Resend
connectors.summary: Send transactional and marketing emails, manage domains, audiences, contacts and broadcasts.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.resend.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" {"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32000,"message":"Unauthorized: provide credentials via Authorization: Bearer <token>"}}

connectors.notes: Remote MCP (launched 2026-07-07) defaults to OAuth, also accepts Bearer API key. npm repo github.com/resend/resend-mcp.

connectors.name: Ringover
connectors.summary: Access Ringover calls, recordings, SMS, contacts, users and call analytics.
connectors.notes: No official MCP found. API key sent raw in Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

connectors.name: Sanity
connectors.summary: Query and edit Sanity content with GROQ, manage documents, schemas, releases and datasets.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="Missing Authorization header", resource_metadata="https://mcp.sanity.io/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"

connectors.notes: @sanity/mcp-server (npm) is deprecated/archived in favor of remote mcp.sanity.io (OAuth).

connectors.name: ScreensDesign
connectors.summary: Search a library of top-grossing iOS app screens, onboarding flows and paywalls with revenue signals, and generate new screens.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer realm="ScreensDesign MCP", resource_metadata="https://api.screensdesign.com/v1/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" {"detail":"Developer API key credentials were not provided."}

connectors.notes: Hosted MCP documented at screensdesign.com/mcp/ (Pro plan); OAuth or scoped API key. No public REST API docs found.

connectors.name: Twilio Segment
connectors.summary: Manage Segment sources, destinations, tracking plans and workspace configuration through the Public API.
connectors.notes: No official Segment MCP found (mcp.segment.com 502). Twilio's docs MCP (https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, 200, no auth) only searches docs incl. Segment; not action-capable.

connectors.name: Semrush
connectors.summary: Pull keyword, domain, backlink and traffic analytics for SEO and competitive research.
connectors.notes: Official remote MCP uses OAuth. npm semrush-mcp is community (superseoworld), not listed. API key passed as ?key= query param.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.summary: Search and triage issues, errors, events, releases and projects in Sentry.
connectors.notes: npm package also supports --host / SENTRY_HOST for self-hosted.

connectors.name: Shopify
connectors.summary: Manage store products, collections, orders, customers, inventory and discounts, and run analytics queries.

api.keyHelp: Shopify admin > Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps

connectors.notes: mcp.shopify.com answers initialize/tools/list without auth but publishes OAuth metadata (authorization_servers https://mcp.shopify.com/auth) for store data. @shopify/dev-mcp is a docs/schema dev server (no store access, no env). Admin API base is per-store.

connectors.name: Similarweb
connectors.summary: Get website traffic, engagement, ranking and competitive intelligence data for any domain.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_request", error_description="Authentication required. Provide either 'api-key' header or 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header."

connectors.notes: Probed at https://mcp.similarweb.com/mcp; docs give https://mcp.similarweb.com. Accepts api-key header or Bearer. Requires a plan with API access.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.summary: Read and send messages, search conversations, and manage channels and users in a Slack workspace.
connectors.notes: @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack (SLACK_BOT_TOKEN, SLACK_TEAM_ID) is deprecated and not Slack-owned, so npm left null.

connectors.name: Smartsheet
connectors.summary: Read and update sheets, rows, columns, workspaces and reports in Smartsheet.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 text/plain {"errorCode":1002,"message":"Your Access Token is invalid.",...} (with dummy Bearer; no www-authenticate)

api.keyHelp: Smartsheet > Account > Personal Settings > API Access

connectors.notes: Vendor docs list https://mcp.smartsheet.com (EU .eu, AU .au) with Bearer API token; requires Business/Enterprise/AWM plan. @smartsheet/smar-mcp 1.6.1 is official but deprecated on npm, so npm null.

connectors.name: Solana
connectors.summary: Look up Solana developer documentation, SDK and program guidance for building on Solana.
connectors.notes: Solana Foundation's MCP is a developer/docs assistant, not a wallet. @solana/mcp (solana-foundation/solana-mcp) appears to proxy the hosted server (SOLANA_MCP_URL optional). Public JSON-RPC (https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com) needs no key, so api null.

connectors.name: Sourcegraph
connectors.summary: Search code across repositories, read files and navigate symbols with Sourcegraph code search.
connectors.notes: Self-hosted instances expose the same path at https://<instance>/.api/mcp/v1. API uses 'Authorization: token <TOKEN>' (GraphQL at /.api/graphql). No official npm MCP found.

connectors.name: Square
connectors.summary: Manage payments, orders, catalog, customers, invoices and inventory in a Square seller account.
connectors.notes: SSE variant https://mcp.squareup.com/sse also returns OAuth 401. npm square-mcp-server published by block-oss-releases (Block, Square's parent).

connectors.name: Strapi
connectors.summary: Create, read, update, publish and unpublish content entries in a Strapi CMS instance.
connectors.notes: Self-hosted: official built-in MCP (Strapi 5.49+ GA) served at https://<instance>/mcp when server.mcp.enabled=true, auth with Admin tokens; no vendor-hosted URL. REST base is https://<instance>/api.

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.summary: Manage customers, payments, invoices, subscriptions, products and refunds in Stripe.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP supports OAuth or a restricted API key as Bearer.

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.summary: Manage Supabase projects, run SQL, inspect tables, migrations, edge functions and logs.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.supabase.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" {"message":"No access token provided"}

connectors.notes: API entry is the Management API; project data APIs are at https://<ref>.supabase.co.

connectors.name: SurveyMonkey
connectors.summary: Create surveys, list collectors and fetch survey responses and results.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain (not confirmed in vendor docs).

connectors.name: Tally
connectors.summary: Create and edit forms, browse the workspace and fetch form submissions in Tally.
connectors.notes: MCP also accepts 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>' per Tally docs. Free on all plans.

connectors.name: TokPortal
connectors.summary: Operate managed TikTok, Instagram and YouTube accounts: create accounts, upload and schedule video bundles, warm accounts and read analytics.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP accepts OAuth or 'X-API-Key: sk_...' header. npm repo github.com/tokportal/tokportal-mcp.

connectors.name: TrendTrack
connectors.summary: Research e-commerce brands and Shopify stores: look up shops, ads, traffic and track competitor brands.
connectors.notes: MCP supports OAuth or API key (docs). No npm package found.

connectors.name: trivago
connectors.summary: Search hotels and accommodations and compare prices across booking sites.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP is free and needs no auth. No public API-key REST API.

connectors.name: Typeform
connectors.summary: Create and update forms, manage workspaces and webhooks, and retrieve form responses.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://api.typeform.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource" scope="accounts:read ... forms:write responses:read ..." {"error":"not authorized"}

connectors.notes: EU accounts: https://api.eu.typeform.com/mcp or https://api.typeform.eu/mcp. Streamable HTTP only (no SSE).

connectors.name: Uber
connectors.summary: Get ride options, fare and ETA estimates between two locations (booking handed off to the Uber app).
connectors.notes: Endpoint path is Claude-partner specific (rides-3p); tools/list works without auth. Uber's rider APIs are restricted/OAuth partner access, so api null.

connectors.name: Udemy
connectors.summary: Search and recommend Udemy Business courses and learning content inside AI workflows.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP for Udemy Business customers (OAuth). Udemy Business REST API is per-organization (org subdomain, client id/secret) so api left null.

connectors.name: Unipile
connectors.summary: Send and read LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram and email messages, and manage connected accounts via one API.
connectors.notes: MCP handshake needs no auth; API calls require passing X-API-KEY header in the MCP client config. API base uses the account-specific DSN shown in the dashboard. No official npm MCP (only @unipile/sdk).

connectors.name: Viator
connectors.summary: Search tours, activities and attractions by destination, with details, availability and pricing.
connectors.notes: MCP initialize works without auth (a directory claims OAuth). Partner API access requires approved affiliate/merchant partnership.

connectors.name: Vocci
connectors.summary: Bring conversations captured by the Vocci AI note-taking ring into AI tools as notes and transcripts.
connectors.notes: Vocci (vocci.ai) is a wearable AI ring; pricing mentions a 'Vocci MCP Server' but no public endpoint/API docs found (developer program is invite-only).

connectors.name: Waalaxy
connectors.summary: Read LinkedIn prospect lists and campaigns and import prospects into Waalaxy lists and campaigns.
connectors.notes: Official MCP (docs.waalaxy.com/mcp-server), OAuth 2.1 with magic link; Advanced/Business plans only. No public API-key REST API confirmed.

connectors.name: Webex
connectors.summary: Send and manage messages, spaces, memberships and meetings in Cisco Webex.

api.keyHelp: developer.webex.com > Getting started (personal token) or bot token

connectors.notes: Meetings server at https://mcp.webexapis.com/mcp/webex-meeting. Admin must enable MCP in Control Hub; requires spark:mcp scope (OAuth or WCIT token).

connectors.name: Webflow
connectors.summary: Manage Webflow sites, pages, CMS collections and items, and publish changes.

api.keyHelp: Webflow site settings > Apps & Integrations > API access

connectors.notes: npm package maintained by webflow-bot (tech@webflow.com).

connectors.name: Windsor.ai
connectors.summary: Query unified marketing and ads performance data (spend, impressions, clicks, conversions) across connected sources.
connectors.notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain. API: https://connectors.windsor.ai/{connector}?api_key=...&fields=...

connectors.name: Wispr Flow
connectors.summary: Read Wispr Flow Notetaker meeting summaries, transcripts, scratchpad notes, tasks and calendar events.
connectors.notes: Requires Notetaker + Cloud Sync enabled. No public developer REST API found.

connectors.name: Wix
connectors.summary: Manage Wix sites, stores, products, bookings, contacts and content.

api.keyHelp: Wix account > API Keys Manager (also send wix-site-id or wix-account-id header)

connectors.notes: @wix/mcp is published by Wix CI (no env; flags like --tools/--portals).

connectors.name: WordPress
connectors.summary: Create, edit and publish posts and pages, and manage media, comments and site settings.

api.keyHelp: WP admin > Users > Profile > Application Passwords

connectors.notes: Remote MCP is WordPress.com (enable under account 'AI and MCP'); URL found by probing, not seen in vendor docs. npm package (Automattic) bridges to self-hosted sites running the WordPress MCP plugin; also supports JWT_TOKEN.

connectors.name: WorkOS
connectors.summary: Manage WorkOS organizations, users, SSO connections, directories and audit logs.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer error="unauthorized", error_description="Authorization needed", resource_metadata="https://mcp.workos.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"

connectors.notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain (not confirmed in vendor docs).

connectors.name: Wrike
connectors.summary: Create and update tasks, projects, folders and comments, and query work in Wrike.
connectors.notes: Vendor docs give remote MCP https://mcp.wrike.com/v2 (OAuth or PAT as Bearer), but probe returned '401 text/plain Unauthorized' with no www-authenticate, so not counted as verified.

connectors.name: X (Twitter)
connectors.summary: Post, search and read tweets, look up users and manage engagement on X.

api.keyHelp: developer.x.com > Projects & Apps > Keys and tokens

connectors.notes: Official XMCP (github.com/xdevplatform/xmcp) is Python, run locally; hosted api.x.com/mcp reported by third parties and confirmed by probe. Docs MCP at https://docs.x.com/mcp. User-context writes need OAuth 2.0.

connectors.name: YouTube
connectors.summary: Search videos and channels and read video, playlist, comment and channel data.
connectors.notes: No official Google-hosted YouTube MCP found (mcp.youtube.com 502); only community servers. Uploads/account actions require OAuth.

connectors.name: Zapier
connectors.summary: Run actions across thousands of apps connected to the user's Zapier account.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/json www-authenticate: Bearer realm="Zapier MCP", error="invalid_token" {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":null,"error":{"code":-31996,"message":"Expected Bearer token for MCP authentication"}}

connectors.notes: Generate the MCP server token/URL at mcp.zapier.com. No general-purpose API-key REST API for running actions.

connectors.name: Zernio
connectors.summary: Schedule and publish social posts across 15+ platforms, manage comments, DMs, ads and analytics.
connectors.notes: npm zernio-mcp is community (Eyalm321); official SDK is @zernio/node.

connectors.name: ZipRecruiter
connectors.summary: Search live job listings by title, company, location, salary and work style.
connectors.notes: Hosted jobseeker MCP answers without auth; reportedly rate-limited. No public job-search REST API.

connectors.name: ZoomInfo
connectors.summary: Search and enrich company and contact B2B data, intent signals and org charts.

remoteMcp.probe: 401 application/vnd.api+json www-authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="https://mcp.zoominfo.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" {"detail":"The Authorization token is required..."}

api.keyHelp: Obtain via POST /authenticate with ZoomInfo API credentials (admin portal)

connectors.notes: Remote MCP URL found by probing the vendor domain. REST API uses short-lived JWT from username + password/private key, not a static key.
